overview_description.description: Spott is an eCommerce-only insurance solution that protects online stores from unexpected losses. With a new breed of dynamic insurance products, the company addresses the risks of lawsuits and sales disruptions. Spott strengthens eCommerce businesses by providing one-click coverage at the best price.
